Using symmetry and oddness:
\[
f(\log_2 20)=f(2+\log_2 5)=f(2-(2+\log_2 5))=f(-\log_2 5)=-f(\log_2 5).
\]
Then
\[
f(\log_2 5)=f(2-\log_2 5).
\]
Since \(2-\log_2 5 \in (-1,0)\), apply the given formula:
\[
f(2-\log_2 5)=2^{2-\log_2 5}+\frac65=\frac45+\frac65=2.
\]
Thus
\[
f(\log_2 20)=-2.
\]

\boxed{-2}
